structure: Part 7 read the 9 specs under tests/animals/e2e/features/address-book in full (addresses-add-handshake 423 lines, addresses-picker 227, addresses-edit 216, addresses-copied 200, addresses-same-as 151, address-book-navigation 160, addresses-submit-freeze 106, addresses-read-only 84, transporter-added-via-address-book 65; 1,632 lines, 36 real test functions once each file's test.describe and test.slow() calls are discounted from the partition's "test(" counts), together with every support file the partition named: page-objects/animals/{addresses-page, party-picker-page, party-edit-page, contact-address-page, permanent-address-page, transporter-page, transporter-add-page}.ts, page-objects/shared/{party-edit-form, address-picker-results, base-page}.ts, page-objects/ins/address-book/{add-page, form-page, shared-form-fields, address-type-page, url-with-return, list-page}.ts, domain/shared/constants/{address-types, journey-party-names, test-record-names}.ts, domain/ins/constants/{address-book-journey, address-book-types, address-form, trader-address, address-details}.ts, flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts, flows/animals/journey.ts, fixtures/ui.ts, utils/{address-book-cleanup, roles-options-assertions}.ts and bin/reset-e2e-address-book.ts. It also read, as context for verbatim copy and the pages each spec reaches, domain/animals/constants/consignment-addresses-page.ts, page-objects/animals/index.ts (the picker and edit page slugs and headings), flows/animals/seeded-journey.ts (the createDraft*/createSubmitted* helpers the specs use) and the reviewHeadingText and expectOpenFromReview helpers. Covered: the add hand-off from each of the five party pickers and from the contact address page to the INS frontend's /address-book/add and back (save-and-select, save-and-return, save-and-continue, cancel, Back, banner lifetime, the roles question, the country select, validation); the Consignment addresses page's party rows, their Add, Change, Edit details and same-as controls; each party picker's role filter, search, eight-a-page paging, chosen-address restatement, row layout and View link; what a journey edit of a copied address changes and does not change; addresses being copied rather than linked, including book rename and delete; the submit freeze on a submitted notification and its amendment; the cross-service navigation and return-URL honouring between the animals journey and the INS address book; and a transporter created in the address book reaching the journey's transporter list. Seven gaps are recorded where the constants in the slice name something no test in it asserts.
